cancelledChap.reason: Author reduced CHAP to one repetition; stopped using the existing graceful cancellation signal.

policy: Do not run CHAP again. Preserve the completed first repetition and cancelled partial second repetition separately. Do not fabricate a second CHAP result or a two-repetition CHAP average. Report actual sample counts; no other numerical threshold or minimum sample size has been waived. Original scoring algorithms remain unchanged. For program metrics that include CHAP, show single-run or pooled descriptive values and explicitly mark the original balanced two-repetition average inapplicable. OPEN-only and role-only metrics retain their existing two-repetition calculations. All historical failures, unknown evidence and costs remain.
